bugs.title: MACD histogram returns macd_line instead of macd_line - signal_line
bugs.symptom: All macd_hist values in coin_tracker.db are wrong — equal to macd_line, not the actual histogram
bugs.root_cause: macd() at line 64 returns (macd_line, None, macd_line) — third element should be macd_line - signal_line, but signal_line is never computed
bugs.fix: Compute signal line as EMA of macd_line over `signal` period, then return (macd_line, signal_line, macd_line - signal_line)

bugs.title: Connection leaks in coin_tracker_backfill.py — no try/finally
bugs.symptom: If backfill throws, candles_conn and write_conn leak (never closed)
bugs.root_cause: candles_conn (line 30) and write_conn (line 50) opened outside try/finally blocks
bugs.fix: Wrap backfill logic in try/finally to ensure both connections close

bugs.title: SQLite connection leak in _read_regime()
bugs.symptom: Connection to signals_hermes.db leaked on query failure
bugs.root_cause: _read_regime() opens conn at line 96 but close() at line 100 is only reached on success — exception skips close
bugs.fix: Wrap in try/finally: conn = sqlite3.connect(...); try: ... finally: conn.close()

bugs.title: Backfill spread uses wrong candle's highs/lows
bugs.symptom: Spread_bps values in backfilled events are incorrect — computed from candle i+1 range, not candle i
bugs.root_cause: At iteration i, h_highs[-1] and h_lows[-1] are from candle i+1 (sliced array), but price is from candle i
bugs.fix: Use highs[i] and lows[i] instead of h_highs[-1] and h_lows[-1]

bugs.title: Silent except:pass hides real errors in batch readers
bugs.symptom: Schema changes, DB corruption, or permission errors silently swallowed — no log output
bugs.root_cause: _read_candles_batch (line 72) and _read_signals_batch (line 89) catch Exception and pass without logging
bugs.fix: Add logging: except Exception as e: print(f'[coin_tracker] WARN batch read: {e}')

bugs.title: ATR only uses first period candles instead of full range
bugs.symptom: ATR values are based on only the first 14 candles of data, not the full available range
bugs.root_cause: atr() line 71 loops range(min(period, len(closes)-1)) — caps at period candles
bugs.fix: Loop over all candles: for i in range(1, len(closes)), compute TR for each, then average

bugs.title: compute_coin_regime() biases to BEAR when EMA is None
bugs.symptom: Coins with <20 candles get unfair bearish regime because None comparisons count as bearish
bugs.root_cause: price > None evaluates to False in Python, incrementing bear counter
bugs.fix: Guard each EMA comparison: if ema_20 is not None: if price > ema_20: bull += 1 else: bear += 1

bugs.title: Global _TABLE_EXISTS_CACHE not process-safe
bugs.symptom: If two processes run coin_tracker simultaneously, they share stale cache and may skip table creation
bugs.root_cause: Module-level _TABLE_EXISTS_CACHE set persists across process boundaries via import cache
bugs.fix: Clear cache on each init_db() call, or use DB-level table existence checks instead of module cache

bugs.title: Backfill regime_conn not in try/finally
bugs.symptom: Minor connection leak if regime query fails
bugs.root_cause: regime_conn at line 41 opened without try/finally

bugs.title: Per-coin JSON writes leave orphaned .tmp files on failure
bugs.symptom: If os.replace() fails, .tmp files accumulate in coin_tracker_coins/
bugs.root_cause: No cleanup of .tmp files in exception path
bugs.fix: Add try/finally to remove .tmp on failure, or accept rare orphaned files

bugs.title: signal_compactor.py: PostgreSQL connections may leak on exception in _get_token_wr
bugs.symptom: PostgreSQL connections opened at lines 51-52 and 89-90 may not close on exception
bugs.root_cause: _get_token_wr (line 50-75) and _get_open_tokens (line 87-97) open psycopg2 connections but only call cur.close(); conn.close() in the happy path. If an exception occurs between open and close, the connection leaks.
bugs.fix: Wrap in try/finally to ensure conn.close() is always called

bugs.title: coin_tracker_schema.py: Duplicated table creation code in ensure_coin_table
bugs.symptom: Table creation SQL is duplicated between conn-provided (lines 126-156) and standalone (lines 166-196) paths
bugs.root_cause: Two identical CREATE TABLE blocks exist — one for when conn is provided, one for standalone mode. If schema changes, both must be updated.
bugs.fix: Extract table creation SQL into a shared constant or helper function

bugs.title: hermes_constants.py: CONFLUENCE_REQUIRED and ACCEL_300_STANDALONE_BYPASS_ENABLED may be missing
bugs.symptom: signal_compactor.py imports CONFLUENCE_REQUIRED and ACCEL_300_STANDALONE_BYPASS_ENABLED from hermes_constants (line 26), but these are not visible in the first 732 lines of hermes_constants.py
bugs.root_cause: False alarm — CONFLUENCE_REQUIRED (line 1258) and ACCEL_300_STANDALONE_BYPASS_ENABLED (line 1264) exist in hermes_constants.py beyond the truncation point
bugs.fix: No fix needed — file was truncated at line 732 during audit

bugs.title: Preserved solo-bypass signals expired before decider can execute them
bugs.symptom: ct-hot signals pass confluence gate via solo bypass, get written as APPROVED via PRESERVE-APPROVED-UPSERT, then immediately expired by Step 13 expiry logic before decider_run reads them. Decider reports no signals above 50% confidence because no PENDING/APPROVED signals exist.
bugs.root_cause: signal_compactor.py Step 12 PRESERVE-APPROVED-UPSERT (line 1698-1715) writes preserved signals as decision=APPROVED. Step 13 (lines 1958-1976) then expires ALL APPROVED signals whose combo_key is not found in any PENDING signal from the last 5 minutes. Since the preserved signal is the ONLY signal for this token+direction (no PENDING row exists), approved_ids stays empty, the else branch fires, and the APPROVED signal gets expired. The decider (line 2229) calls get_approved_signals() which queries decision=APPROVED AND executed=0 - finds nothing.
bugs.fix: signal_compactor.py Step 13 (lines 1936-1980): Added AND combo_key NOT IN (top10_combos) to BOTH the if and else branches of the APPROVED signal expiry logic. This prevents expiring APPROVED signals whose combo_key is in the current hotset_final, regardless of whether approved_ids is empty or not. The if branch was the one actually firing (PENDING signals exist), not the else branch.
bugs.verified_by: Agent trace: BIGTIME SHORT written as APPROVED at 06:17:22, expired at same second by Step 13, decider at 06:19:33 found 0 signals.

bugs.title: profit_monster trailing activation units mismatch — false activation at 0.01%
bugs.symptom: BSV and GRASS trades closed immediately by trailing stop at near-zero profit. BSV activated at pnl=0.01% instead of required 0.60%.
bugs.root_cause: PM_TRAIL_ACTIVATE_PCT=0.006 (decimal) compared against live_pnl_pct in percent (0.01). 0.01 >= 0.006 = True → false activation.
bugs.fix: Multiply PM_TRAIL_ACTIVATE_PCT and PM_TRAIL_DISTANCE_PCT by 100 at import to convert from decimal to percent.
bugs.verified_by: Bug hunter audit: all 4 usage sites verified correct with percent units.
